Method of Attack: Uses a preinstall hook to execute a malicious script before installation, harvesting system data and sensitive information such as usernames and passwords, and sending it to a remote server using a dynamically generated URL

Overwrites local files used by Atomic Wallet and Exodus with malicious versions that contain the legitimate functionality of the original but replace outgoing crypto addresses with the attacker’s crypto address. Also sends a ZIP archive to a remote server.
Impacted Systems: cryptocurrency wallet applications Atomic Wallet and Exodus
Attack Vector: Tricks developers into installing the package by using PayPal-related themes
Poses as a library that supports the conversion of PDF files to Microsoft Office documents
Indicators of Compromise: Unusual NPM packages with names like ‘paypal’
Unexpected network connections to unknown servers
ZIP archive sent to a remote server
